no_statistic_outcomes: E4b: a line whose boosted lambda~1 rows share one MAP has no reference line and decides nothing; with no other deciding line E4b has no statistic
E4b: a data lever that sums to zero over the deciding lines leaves eps undefined: no statistic

E4b held out: with fewer than 2 enriched rows over the deciding lines the pooled u_stat is undefined (the enriched side has no variance of its own), so E4b is labelled but cannot certify, and reads untested unless it is off (WP3's second fix of 23 October 2026)

E4b in-sample: on the same fewer than 2 enriched rows the u_stat decision 77's rule needs is undefined, so the statistic can neither be shown to fail beyond its noise (|E_cal| - 2 u_stat > R) nor pass (2 u_stat <= R): it neither blocks a form nor passes it, recorded per form with its noise-exceeding statistics (epa_stats.NO_U_STAT; declared 23 October 2026, before Run 1, with decision 77)

C3b and C3d: a row whose u_val is incomplete (u_num, u_D or u_stat missing) has no statistic; the C3 chain's u-terms are read from the D3 files, which the arming hashes and the run first reads (C5), so this is a declared outcome of the one run, not an arm-time check
declarations.d1_torque_target_u_d: in u_val: EPA's torque reading moves D1's inversion target; each cluster re-evaluated at its torque reading + torque's u_D (torque_target_shift), random
